monuments.materials: Gray limestone masonry, dry stone joinery, iron cramps
monuments.description: Double-tiered square plinth stupa with four corner projections and central staircases on all four sides.
monuments.archaeological_evidence: Excavated by Daya Ram Sahni in 1912-13; preserved base plinths and stone finial fragments.
monuments.current_condition: Foundations and lower tiered plinth preserved within ASI fenced enclosure.

monuments.description: Square stone shrine hall housing a sanctum with an 80-ton monolithic stone floor slab surrounded by an ambulatory passage.
monuments.archaeological_evidence: Excavated by Sahni 1912-13; recorded by Kak 1933.
monuments.current_condition: Plinth and cella monolithic slab intact; upper walls missing.

people.name: Lalitaditya Muktapida
people.relationship_with_parihaspora: Founder and patron of Parihaspora as imperial capital city
people.major_contributions: Military expansion across North-Western India, founding Parihaspora, commissioning Martand Sun Temple & Parihaskeshava
people.archaeological_evidence: Foundational monuments at Parihaspora, Martand, and Ushkur

people.name: Cankuna (Chankuna)
people.relationship_with_parihaspora: Patron of Buddhist Stupa, Chaitya, and Vihara at Parihaspora
people.major_contributions: Key Buddhist architectural patron and Central Asian diplomat
people.archaeological_evidence: Stupa and Chaitya plinths at Parihaspora

artifacts.artifact_name: Carved Relief Block depicting Seated Buddha
artifacts.description: High relief stone block portraying a seated Buddha in dhyanamudra flanked by attendants.
artifacts.historical_significance: Key visual proof of Kashmiri-Gandharan artistic synthesis during Karkota era.
